snippets.snippet_text: "Gumroad Affiliates earn a fixed 10% commission on each sale. From the Gumroad Affiliates dashboard, anyone can generate affiliate links for Gumroad Discover, specific products, and creator profile pages. These links, which are specific to this one's affiliate account, will add a browser cookie when clicked and track any purchases made via this link. This cookie will only be active for 7 days."
